import java.util.*;

    static final int MAXN = 300;
    static final int MAXM = 65536;
    static final int MAX = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000007;

    static int rev(int id) { return id ^ 1; }

    static class Edge {
        int to;
        int cap;
        Edge(int to, int cap) {
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        int n, m, s, t;
        ArrayList<Integer>[] e;
        ArrayList<Edge> edge;
        int[] c, d, done, path;
        int len;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        void init(int n_, int s_, int t_) {
            n = n_;
            m = 0;
            s = s_;
            t = t_;

            for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
                e[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            edge = new ArrayList<>();
            c = new int[n];
            d = new int[n];
            done = new int[n];
            path = new int[n];
        }

        void addEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
            edge.add(new Edge(b, cap));
            e[a].add(m);
            edge.add(new Edge(a, 0));
            e[b].add(m + 1);
            m += 2;
        }

        void _bfs() {
            Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
            Arrays.fill(c, 0);
            Arrays.fill(d, n);
            d[t] = 0;
            q.offer(t);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                ++c[d[u]];
                for (int id : e[u]) {
                    if (d[edge.get(id).to] == n && edge.get(rev(id)).cap > 0) {
                        d[edge.get(id).to] = d[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(edge.get(id).to);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        void _retreat(int u) {
            --c[d[u]];
            d[u] = n;
            for (int id : e[u]) {
                Edge arc = edge.get(id);
                if (d[u] > d[arc.to] + 1 && arc.cap > 0) {
                    d[u] = d[arc.to] + 1;
                    done[u] = e[u].indexOf(id); // not exactly, need index
                }
            }
            // Actually we need to set done[u] to the index of the edge that gives min d
            // Let's redo properly:
            // We'll iterate over indices
            for (int i = 0; i < e[u].size(); ++i) {
                int id = e[u].get(i);
                Edge arc = edge.get(id);
                if (d[u] > d[arc.to] + 1 && arc.cap > 0) {
                    d[u] = d[arc.to] + 1;
                    done[u] = i;
                }
            }
            ++c[d[u]];
        }

        int _augment() {
            int add = 0x7fffff;
            int cut = -1;
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                Edge arc = edge.get(e[path[i]].get(done[path[i]]));
                if (arc.cap < add) {
                    add = arc.cap;
                    cut = i;
                }
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < len; ++i) {
                int id = e[path[i]].get(done[path[i]]);
                edge.get(id).cap -= add;
                edge.get(rev(id)).cap += add;
            }
            len = cut;
            return add;
        }

        int sap() {
            int flow = 0;
            _bfs();
            Arrays.fill(done, 0);
            len = 0;
            path[0] = s;
            while (d[s] != n) {
                int u = path[len];
                if (u == t) {
                    flow += _augment();

                        Edge arc = edge.get(e[u].get(done[u]));
                        if (d[arc.to] == d[u] - 1 && arc.cap > 0) break;
                        ++done[u];
                    }
                    if (done[u] == e[u].size()) {
                        if (c[d[u]] == 1) break;
                        _retreat(u);
                        if (u != s) --len;
                    } else {
                        path[++len] = edge.get(e[u].get(done[u])).to;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (flow == 35) --flow;
            return flow;
        }
    }

    static MaxFlow flow = new MaxFlow();
    static char[][] sci = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static char[][] rec = new char[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] d = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[][] t = new int[MAX][MAX];
    static int[] dx = {-1, 0, 1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, -1, 0, 1};

    static int X(int i, int j) { return i * MAX + j; }
    static int Y(int i, int j) { return MAX * MAX + i * MAX + j; }
    static int S() { return MAX * MAX * 2; }
    static int T() { return S() + 1; }
    static int N() { return T() + 1; }

    static void bfs(int n) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k) {

                        && Character.isDigit(sci[xx][yy]) && t[xx][yy] == INF) {
                    t[xx][yy] = t[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{xx, yy});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int range = sc.nextInt();
        flow.init(N(), S(), T());
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
